title: Gentility
summary: GENTIL'ITY, noun 1. Politeness of manners; easy, graceful behavior; the manners of well bred people; genteelness. 2. Good extraction; dignity of birth. 3. Gracefulness of mien. 4. Gentry. [Not in use.
